findings.quote: Title I of ERISA of Section 4975 of the Code
findings.explanation: The phrase incorrectly merges Title I of ERISA with Section 4975 of the Internal Revenue Code, creating confusion about which legal provision is being referenced.
interpretations: The drafter intended to refer to Title I of ERISA.
The drafter intended to refer to Section 4975 of the Code.
The phrase as written denotes a nonsensical combined provision that does not exist.

findings.explanation: The provision appears in Section 12 but references Section 11, indicating a misnumbered or missing cross‑reference.
interpretations: The reference should point to Section 12 (the current section).
Section 11 exists elsewhere but the referenced paragraphs are not present.
The drafter made a typographical error in the section number.
